first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender dark gray long gun at the bottom of the image, with a mottled surface, moving continuously from slightly right of the lower center toward the lower left.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, uneven muddy ground, low-lying trenches, mud ridges, and scattered rocks extending from the foreground to the midground, with wet, bright reflections in some areas.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: A collection of gray ruined brick-and-stone walls with damaged outlines, including the distant wall on the right at the beginning and the nearby wall on the left in the later part.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: A collection of gray-black leafless trunks, short branches, and broken stumps, with a thick diagonally broken stump on the right at the beginning.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The gray-white, yellow-green to pale warm-yellow background sky in the upper part of the effective image, partially occluded by smoke clouds and image overlays.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: Localized glowing orange-yellow flame areas near the ground in the middle distance.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person identified by the dark-gloved hand gripping beside Weapon A; the face and full body are outside the image.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: Gray to gray-black masses of smoke with uneven density and blurred edges in the background from the left to the center.

entities.name: black speck overlay
entities.identification: Blurred black specks along the upper edge and edges of the effective image, remaining approximately fixed relative to the frame in the later part.

entities.name: warm-color image filter
entities.identification: An overall image effect in which the sky, walls, and reflections on the muddy ground simultaneously become warmer, initially pinkish orange and then weakening.
